label: ACTUAL_DESIGN_EVALUATION / PARAMETRIC (compressor coefficients and surface accommodation are engineering assumptions) / NOT_VALIDATED / NOT_A_PERFORMANCE_PREDICTION
registered_before: any evaluation code of this DCR and any computation on any replacement design. Results seen before registration: those listed in dcr_register_v2.json results_seen_before_request (DBF-1, M2 v1, A4, A5, F1, F3, F4, F7, F8 committed records). The registrant's only additional reasoning was a back-of-envelope reading of committed numbers: at fixed geometry the necessary-flow and drag-filter conditions both scale with A, so closure requires a sufficiently high ratio of worst-state capture efficiency to densest-state intake C_D; no candidate value was computed.
frozen_concept_retained: atmospheric intake (multichannel TPMC-ROM intake) -> filter -> active compressor (turbomolecular rows and Gaede / Holweck drag stages of the admitted DragCompressor family) -> plenum -> pressure-regulated feed orifice -> H-1. No new propulsion or compression family, no new physics; only implementation parameters of the existing registered models are varied (A9.38 sec. 1; CLAUDE.md rule 8).

models.intake: F1 IF-A1 unit-area records (direct TPMC, theta 0) scaled by A (d-invariant at fixed L/d, F1-02; flows and the intake backflow term are proportional to A, p_passive and K_back are intensive) through abep_design::f1view::load_f1_records; intake-face drag = F1 drag per unit frontal area (abep_mission::intake_drag::drag_table) x A
models.chain: admitted steady chain abep_gaspath::plenum_feed (intake_side, steady_sweep with its fail-closed reason bits; steady_operating_point for the detailed record of the selected design)
models.stability: contract-v8 input-only stability class (event_sequence equilibria; S / U / R). Screening by abep_gaspath::transient::stability_class_events (Rust). Authoritative class of the selected design: the governed Python reference (A9.34: plenum / feed v8 PARITY_FAIL stands, the Python reference governs the transient path) by a new script scripts/dcr001/dcr001_feed_stability_reference.py that applies the M2 reference method (scripts/m2/dbf1_feed_stability_reference.py: TransientRun, event_sequence, the v7 / v8 harness _py_equilibrium) to the selected design and coefficient set; Rust must agree on every row (class and equilibrium kinds) or the result is MODEL_ERROR and nothing is selected
models.requirement: A4 K-MDOT-REQ (abep_mission::conservation_bounds::mdot_required) at P_avail(s) + q_max(s) A, with P_avail(s) and q_max(s) read per state from the committed A4 record (AIR_PRIMARY), exactly the A8 mdot_req,in

intake_area_m2.basis: continuous aperture scan around and above the A4 area (0.2511 m^2) and the F1 grid; A4-REG-01 open: no area limit is invented (A9.35)

L_over_d.basis: F1 / intake_surface_v1 grid nodes; never interpolated (F1 coverage rule)

variables.channel_diameter: collapsed (F1-02); set with the mechanical design inside the F1 grid 5-20 mm

filter.basis: every architecture-context filter case; F4-FIL-NONE is a reference bound only, never admissible (A9.13 S6.5)

compressor.values: every design of the F3 design grid (f3_compressor_designs_v1.json, 2160 designs: N_turbo 1-6, A_turbo 3 values, hub ratio 0-0.75, turbo tip speed 6 points to 500 m/s, N_drag 0-4, Ti6Al4V) that carries none of the F3 inlet-independent gate codes R1 / R2 / R3 (rotor allowable, rotor stress with the cited Ti-6Al-4V A-basis Fty and safety factor 2, tip speed <= 500 m/s); the codes must be identical in every F3 case, else MODEL_ERROR
compressor.basis: topology (turbo rows, drag stages), speed and size of the existing DragCompressor family

plenum_set_pressure_Pa.basis: F7 target grid; the free-molecular model domain ends at 0.1 Pa (A9.13 S6.8); single fixed setpoint (an orbit-scheduled setpoint, OQ-F4-01, is not a registered control mode and is excluded)

controller.values: Kp in {0.3, 3.0}, Ti in {0.3, 3.0} s, f_valve 1 Hz, authority 3
controller.basis: registered F4 grid (definition one-decade grid; f_valve / authority the only registered values)

design_space.scenarios: all 10 admitted TPMC surface scenarios (maxwell / cll x alpha 0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1); none chosen (A9.13 S6.16)
design_space.states: all 196 required design states of atmosphere_msis21_orbit_v1_design_states_v2 (the F1 design-case reference h200_f150 is not a required state)
design_space.size: 360 intake geometries x 4 filters x N_C compressors x 3 volumes x 6 set pressures x 4 controllers; the record states N_C and the total. The steady chain is independent of V (WALL-G0: no recombination, fixed leak area; asserted by a test) and of the controller, so steady evaluation is per (intake, filter, compressor, P_set, scenario)

compressor_model_provenance.rule: no repository source gives a value for any fixed DragCompressor coefficient (F3 coefficients, compressor_downselect CD-01). Each is frozen at its code default as a FROZEN_ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION (evidence class assumed, level 7) with the uncertainty band below; cited relations bound or cross-check a band where the repository has them. The admissibility evaluation uses the nominal values; the robustness check repeats every criterion at the unfavourable corners. A result that closes only at nominal is labelled CONDITIONAL_ON_COMPRESSOR_COEFFICIENTS.

coefficients.name: turbo_kS
coefficients.role: turbo pumping speed S = kS u_t A_turbo
coefficients.bound: upper physical limit S <= A c_bar / 4 (orifice limit, compressor_downselect EV-20 form; Chiggiato 2013 Eq. 46 EV-01 for the drag-stage analogue) -> kS <= c_bar / (4 u_t), >= 0.24 for O2 at 350 K up to 500 m/s: the band upper end is a plausibility bound only

coefficients.name: turbo_kK
coefficients.role: per-row ln K0 = kK u_t / c_bar
coefficients.bound: cross-check only: classical TMP K0(H2) ~ 1e3 (Chiggiato 2013 Sec. 4.1.2, EV-03) with an unstated row count; the form ln K0 ~ sqrt(m) is cited (EV-02)

coefficients.name: xi
coefficients.bound: xi <= 1 (ideal S = u b h / 2, EV-01)

coefficients.name: eta_motor
coefficients.bound: power cross-check: P_el >= P_pneumatic / 0.01 (TMP thermodynamic efficiency 1-10 %, Singh 2014 citing Hablanian 1993, EV-05, verify) reported for the selected design

coefficients.name: stress_safety
coefficients.evidence: assumed (code default); the rotor gate uses the cited Ti-6Al-4V A-basis Fty 827 MPa (NASA-HDBK-6025 quoting MMPDS-06); flight rotor acceptance only through a registered strength basis (A9.9 S2.3)

coefficients.name: h_mm, w_mm, L_per_stage_m, rotor_radius_m
coefficients.evidence: frozen drag-stage geometry assumptions (design dimensions of a drag stage, not model coefficients); they become design values only if a drag-stage design is selected

compressor_model_provenance.cited_parameters_retained: molecular-regime limit 0.1 Pa (Chiggiato 2013 Sec. 4.1.2), drag-channel Kn >= 0.5 (Chiggiato Table 7), tip speed <= 500 m/s (Chiggiato Sec. 4.1.2), Ti-6Al-4V A-basis Fty 827 MPa (NASA-HDBK-6025); rotor density 4430 kg/m^3 and T_max 700 K stay uncited DB priors (verify)

corners.rule: monotone coefficients (mass: m increases with every mass coefficient; power: P_el increases with blade fraction, k_bear, P_ctrl and decreases with eta_motor; thermal: T_comp increases as the sink conductance falls and T_sink rises) are set to their unfavourable end in every corner; the flow-path coefficients (kS, kK, leak; xi for drag stages) whose effect on flow, domain and stability is not shown monotone are taken at all 2^3 combinations of their band ends (xi at its unfavourable end throughout)
corners.applied_to: every criterion (flow, domain, power, mass, stability) of the admissible designs (steady) and of the selected design (stability, Rust screen and Python reference)

criteria.quantifier: every criterion is evaluated over the COMPLETE governed set: all 196 required states x all 10 admitted surface scenarios (never a nominal state, never a chosen scenario)
criteria.C-FLOW-T12: 12 mN sustained (HC-01): at every required state in every scenario the steady point is in domain and mdot_del(s, sc) >= mdot_req,in(s, HC-01, A) = K-MDOT-REQ(HC-01, P_avail(s) + q_max(s) A) (A4 / A8; P_avail = 1500 W, the A4 value: HC-03 minus the eligible non-Hall lower bound 0 W)
criteria.C-FLOW-T25: 25 mN capability (HC-02), A4 existence form: in every scenario at least one required state has an in-domain steady point with mdot_del >= mdot_req,in(s, HC-02, A); the per-state T25 counts are reported
criteria.C-DOMAIN: at every required state in every scenario the steady chain carries no fail-closed reason (no dead-head TARGET_AT_OR_ABOVE_DEAD_HEAD_PRESSURE, Gaede K inside [1, K0], stage / inlet pressure <= 0.1 Pa, feed-orifice Kn >= 0.5, compressor temperature <= the material limit, orifice bisection converged) and the dead-head margin p_dead / P_set - 1 > 0
criteria.C-STAB: feed-loop input-only class S at every required state in every scenario for the design's (V, controller); U (UNSTABLE_EQUILIBRIUM) and R (refused, dead-head) fail
criteria.C-DRAG: intake-face drag <= HC-09 (engineering constraint intake_drag_generation_limit_mN, 25 mN; C-DRAG-RFP) at every required state in every scenario (F1 mean drag; its SE margin is reported)
criteria.C-POWER: compressor electrical power (shaft / eta_motor + bearing + P_ctrl) <= 250 W at every required state in every scenario: the frozen 300 W common-load allocation (DBF1-PWR-03) minus its 50 W controls / thermal allowance; the flow-control valve load is not registered (P6 power lane) and is reported as such
criteria.C-MASS: compressor model mass <= 5.5 kg (AL-02 compressor+drive, mass_power_a9_v5) at every required state in every scenario (torque-dependent motor term); an explicit DCR mass transfer from the mass lane would replace the 5.5 kg (none registered)
criteria.admissible: C-FLOW-T12 and C-FLOW-T25 and C-DOMAIN and C-STAB and C-DRAG and C-POWER and C-MASS at the nominal coefficients
criteria.robust: admissible and every criterion also holds at all 8 unfavourable coefficient corners -> ADMISSIBLE_ROBUST; admissible only at nominal -> ADMISSIBLE_CONDITIONAL_ON_COMPRESSOR_COEFFICIENTS (the failing corners and criteria listed)
information_never_gating: L-AREA: A >= A_req(s, HC-01) (A4 K-AREQ; implied by C-FLOW-T12 since mdot_del <= mdot_cap <= Phi_max A)
INFO-ALLOC: margin against K-MDOT-REQ at the DBF-1 design allocation for Hall + ICP (1350 W - 300 W common = 1050 W, DBF1-PWR-04) + q_max A
delivered composition (x_O, x_N2, x_O2 of the delivered flow), passive and active compression ratios, dead-head margin, Gaede K_min
T_required = D_body(RC-DIAMANT, REFERENCE_PENDING_CUSTOMER_ICD) + D_intake per state (host-drag reference only)
intake geometric wall area 2 phi A L/d and the F1 PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY intake mass case vs AL-01 3.5 kg (structural definition TBD, F1Q-02)
TPMC statistical SE margins of the captured flow and drag

procedure.rule: staged evaluation; every pruning stage applies a necessary condition exactly, so no admissible design is lost; the record gives the count surviving each stage
procedure.S0: compressors: F3 inlet-independent gates R1 / R2 / R3 (design space); C-MASS lower bound m_LB = m_rotor (1 + stator) + motor_kg_per_Nm x 0.01 + 0.25 + bearing (torque floor 0.01 N m) <= 5.5 kg at nominal -> C_mass
procedure.S1: intakes: C-DRAG at every state and scenario -> I_drag
procedure.S2: intakes: captured flow mdot_cap(s, sc) >= mdot_req,in(s, HC-01, A) at every state and scenario (necessary: the delivered flow never exceeds the captured flow by mass conservation of the chain) -> I_cap
procedure.S3: steady chain at nominal coefficients for I_cap x filters x C_mass x P_set x scenarios: C-DOMAIN, C-FLOW-T12, C-FLOW-T25, C-POWER, C-MASS -> D_steady (a (intake, filter, compressor) triple stops being evaluated once every P_set has failed in some scenario)
procedure.S4: the 8 unfavourable corners on D_steady (steady criteria) -> steady-robust flag
procedure.S5: C-STAB lazily in ranking order: designs of D_steady are taken in the order of the selection keys K1-K7; for each, (V, controller) pairs in the order of K8-K9; the first pair that is S at every (state, scenario) by the Rust screen completes the design; the first design so completed is the candidate selection; then the authoritative Python reference with Rust R2 agreement is run on it at nominal and at the 8 corners. If the Python reference finds a non-S row the candidate is not admissible (or not robust, for a corner) and the next design in order is taken. Stability evaluation stops after 200 designs; reaching the cap is reported
procedure.determinism: pure functions of pinned inputs; deterministic ordering (BTreeMap / sorted keys); worker threads only partition independent work and results are merged in index order; the record is produced twice and must be byte-identical

keys: K1: ADMISSIBLE_ROBUST before ADMISSIBLE_CONDITIONAL (steady corners S4)
K2: maximise the robust worst-state T12 flow ratio r12 = min over states, scenarios and the nominal + 8 corner coefficient sets of mdot_del / mdot_req,in(HC-01), in bins of 0.05 (floor(20 r12) / 20)
K2b: maximise the nominal worst-state T12 flow ratio (min over states and scenarios, nominal coefficients), in bins of 0.05
K3: minimise the compressor model mass (max over states and scenarios, nominal), in bins of 0.1 kg
K4: minimise the intake geometric wall area 2 phi A L/d (mass and surface proxy)
K5: maximise P_set (feed-pressure margin to the H-1 inlet, whose requirement is pending, H1F-IN-04 / H23-07)
K6: minimise the maximum intake-face drag
K7: minimise the maximum compressor electrical power
K8: minimise the plenum volume V
K9: controller order (Kp 0.3, Ti 3), (0.3, 0.3), (3, 3), (3, 0.3) (SR-CTRL-01: lowest gain, slowest integral first)

non_closure_rule.trigger: no design of DS-DCR001 is admissible

best_design.set: designs evaluated on the steady chain with the flow criteria relaxed: I_drag x filters x C_mass x P_set (S2 not applied); if no design of that set meets every non-flow criterion (C-DOMAIN, C-STAB, C-DRAG, C-POWER, C-MASS), the set is widened to I_all x filters x all S0 compressors x P_set
keys: N1: minimise the number of failed non-flow criteria (C-DOMAIN, C-STAB, C-DRAG, C-POWER, C-MASS)
N2: maximise r12 at nominal (a state out of domain counts as ratio 0), exact
N3-N11: K2b (nominal ratio bins are superseded by N2 and skipped), K3-K10
best_design.early_termination: when at least one design of the set meets every non-flow steady criterion (C-DOMAIN, C-DRAG, C-POWER, C-MASS), a (intake, filter, compressor, P_set) that fails one of them in some scenario is not evaluated further (it cannot rank first unless every design meeting them fails C-STAB, in which case the set is re-evaluated without early termination); otherwise the set is evaluated without early termination
best_design.stability: as S5, in the N-order; a design whose stability fails gains one N1 count and is re-ranked; capped at 200 designs (reported)

non_closure_rule.report: the best design and its residual shortfall per criterion: k12 = 1 / r12 worst (per scenario and overall, with its state), C-FLOW-T25 per scenario, drag margin, dead-head / Gaede domain counts, stability class counts, power and mass margins; the captured-flow frontier (best min-over-states-and-scenarios mdot_cap / mdot_req,in over I_drag, the compression-independent upper bound of the explored space) per (L/d, phi); the count of states failing T12 per scenario
non_closure_rule.classification: DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT within the explored space (DS-DCR001). FUNDAMENTAL_NON_CLOSURE only if a registered conservation / physics bound proves that no design of the frozen concept can close: the only registered route is A4 CA4 on a FROZEN intake_effective_collection_area_max_m2, and A4-REG-01 stays OPEN (A9.35); this preregistration registers no new bound, so this evaluation cannot conclude FUNDAMENTAL_NON_CLOSURE

resolution_rule.selected: the first design by selection_rule; if none, the best design by non_closure_rule
resolution_rule.successor_baseline: DBF-1.1 in docs/baseline/DBF-1.1/ (new record, config subset and lock; DBF-1 never edited): the DCR items take the selected design's values, compressor coefficients frozen as above with their bands; every other DBF-1 item is carried unchanged by reference; deficiencies re-stated from this evaluation
resolution_rule.dcr_status: APPROVED_BY_COORDINATOR_PENDING_OWNER_NOTE only if the selection rule produced an admissible design (ROBUST, or CONDITIONAL with the condition stated); otherwise CLOSED_WITH_RESIDUAL_DEFICIENCY with the residuals of the non-closure rule

p1_closure_state.ADMISSIBLE_ROBUST: FROZEN FOR EM (design + analysis evidence at the parametric model level; verification by EM test: surface accommodation DI-1.3, compressor coefficients T-1..T-9)
p1_closure_state.ADMISSIBLE_CONDITIONAL: FROZEN FOR EM with the stated coefficient condition as an EM verification requirement
p1_closure_state.NOT_ADMISSIBLE, best design closes in at: BLOCKED BY SPECIFIC MISSING EVIDENCE (surface accommodation DI-1.3 decides between the admitted scenarios) together with the DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT classification
p1_closure_state.NOT_ADMISSIBLE otherwise: DCR REQUIRED (a change outside DS-DCR001 or of a registered filter / allocation is needed; the record names what the residual requires)
p1_closure_state.FUNDAMENTAL NON-CLOSURE: not reachable by this evaluation (see non_closure_rule.classification)

outputs.producer: abep-assess binary abep-dcr001-eval (additive module abep_assess::dcr001) and scripts/dcr001/dcr001_feed_stability_reference.py
cross_checks: the DBF-1 design re-evaluated by this harness reproduces the M2 v1 per-(scenario, state) delivered flows and steady reason bits exactly, and its covered-scenario minima equal the committed F7 values within the A5.1 tolerance
C-DRAG on the F1 grid areas reproduces the F1 envelope feasibility (A5 DS-F1-ADMISSIBLE: only A = 0.25 m^2 at every state)
a failed cross-check is MODEL_ERROR: no record

fail_closed: any pin that does not verify -> no record
a producer MODEL_ERROR, a Python / Rust stability disagreement or a failed cross-check -> no record, nothing selected
a missing quantity is NOT_EVALUATED with its reason, never a pass
not: not a performance prediction, a validation, a qualification or a flight acceptance
not an architecture change, not a change of an RFP requirement, owner allocation or admitted / scored record
not an area limit (A4-REG-01 stays open)
change_control: any change after the lock is a new, dated version of this preregistration; the record of v1 is never rewritten
